title: RLHF: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
description: InstructGPT paper. Demonstrates that a 1.3B RLHF-finetuned model is preferred over a 175B base model by human raters. Three-stage pipeline: supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations, reward model training from human comparisons, PPO optimization against the reward model. This is the recipe for ChatGPT and every instruction-following LLM.
authors: Ouyang, Wu, Jiang, Almeida, Wainwright, Mishkin, Zhang, Agarwal, Slama, Ray, et al. (OpenAI)
